STR_MASTER_SHUTTLE: GX-09 can carry a master and travel quickly, or summon allies from a distant location.
STR_STORY_SHUTTLE:
{color:#fbdc02}Origin{color:end}: Built on Earth, modified by the Dredgion
{color:#fbdc02}Occupation{color:end}: Transport Master
{color:#fbdc02}Personality{color:end}: Strong sense of duty, devoted to service.
{color:#fbdc02}Note{color:end}: Very popular with children.

Before being converted into its current form, GX-09 was transport equipment used on Earth. It was loaded onto the Ark and drifted all the way to Anu, where it became part of the collection of the Dredgion's chief engineer, who has a hobby of collecting old items from Earth. While looking for parts for his own hobby, Moro happened to repair GX-09, and in the process it was revealed that, like MBA-07, GX-09 is an artificial intelligence that reacts to Sol. Moro and the chief engineer both claimed ownership of GX-09, but GX-09, regarding the transport duty it had carried out since Earth as its mission, volunteered as a Dredgion master to support other masters.
STR_SKILL_DESC_180410000:
{color:#35a6e6}[Fuel Recovery]{color:end}
Charged attacks recover 20 Fuel.
Recovers 5 Fuel per second while charging.

{color:#35a6e6}[Plasma Shield]{color:end}
Using a skill creates a shield that absorbs 250 damage for 3 seconds.
STR_SKILL_DESC_180410002:
Moves 8m in the movement direction and gains Super Armor for 1 second.
Recovers 22 Fuel for each enemy in the path.
STR_SKILL_DESC_180410010: Moves {skill:180410010:actionbase:movehorizon} forward, leaving a distorted trail. Enemies on the distorted trail are slowed by {skill:180410010:status:stat:mul:movespeed}% and all targets in the area are pulled toward its center.
STR_SKILL_DESC_180410020:
Drains 30% of the MP and EP of enemy masters in the area.
{color:#e45f5f}Targets that are not masters are Feared.{color:end}
STR_SKILL_DESC_180410030:
Releases a shockwave around GX-09, knocking enemies in the area back to the edge of the shockwave and down.
{color:#e45f5f}The closer to the center, the farther enemies are knocked back.{color:end}
STR_SKILL_DESC_180410040:
Transforms into transport mode. For 3 seconds, allies can board GX-09 with the interaction key.
Transport mode lasts {skill:180410040:stancedurationtime} seconds and increases movespeed by {skill:180410040:status:stat:mul:movespeed}%.
{color:#e45f5f}Passengers are dropped off when the transformation ends, or when GX-09 dies or tags out.{color:end}
STR_SKILL_DESC_180410050: Places a teleporter at an ally's position on the minimap or in the field. After 3 seconds, allies near the teleporter are moved to GX-09's position.
